title: A shadow on the flats
logline: The flats in low October sun, and a man's long shadow across the mud from the page's bottom edge, the pup's shadow beside it, the man himself not in the frame. The sequence's thinnest version of him.

panels.composition: Mudflats in low October sun with a man's long shadow and a small dog's shadow stretching across the mud from the page's bottom edge, the figures themselves out of frame, the chimney far off.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, tidal mudflats in low October sun with a man's long shadow and a small dog's shadow stretching across the mud from the page's bottom edge, the figures out of frame, a distant chimney, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
